All White Attire Party & House of KLynn Fashion Show

Sat, Jun 8, 2024 · 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM · Granada Theater

When
Sat, Jun 8, 2024 · 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM
Where
Granada Theater
3022 Hennepin Ave,, Minneapolis, MN
Cost
$60

IamMoody production presents the All White Attire Party featuring House of KLynn new Hok Bride line at the Granada Theater in Uptown Minneapolis, MN. Get ready to shine in your brightest whites at this epic event at the historic Granada Theater. Join us for a night of music, dancing, and unforgettable memories.

Fashion Show: Featuring: House of KLynn’s new Hok Bride line
Music: DJ Cousin Christopher
Entertainment: Violinist Karu

Whether you’re a seasoned party-goer or just looking for a fun night out, this is the place to be. So grab your friends, put on your best white outfit, and get ready to dance the night away. Don’t miss out on this amazing opportunity to have a blast and show off your style in all-white!

in association with House of KLynn films

Tickets $60

NOTE: Please bring non-perishable food cans for charity.
